unit.why: A short anecdote about R. Menahem Mendel of Rymanów weeping on parting from the Maggid of Kozienice after a Sabbath, and how he was consoled.

stories.start_quote: עוד שמעתי ממנו שסיפר שפ"א כשהי׳
stories.summary_en: After spending a Sabbath with the Maggid of Kozienice, R. Menahem Mendel of Rymanów wept bitterly at having to leave such a rebbe, until his companions consoled him: if the Maggid is truly his rebbe, he knows what he is doing and grieves at his grief.

quotes: מרימינאב אצל המגיד הק׳ ז"ל על ש"ק
tags.why: He came to the Maggid for Shabbat.

quotes: ויהי אחר ש"ק כאשר נתפרד לשלום
tags.why: The visit and the parting are set around Shabbat.

quotes: הצטער מאד ובכה בכי רב בדמעות שליש
tags.why: His grief at parting is the core of the story.
His attachment to the Maggid as his rebbe is central.

quotes: הלא ידעתם שיודע מה אתם עושים פה
tags.why: The consolation rests on faith in the rebbe's awareness of, and bond with, his disciple.
The companions assume the rebbe knows at a distance what is happening.

quotes: והאנשים שהיו אתו דברו על לבו

tags.why: The text gives its chain of oral transmission.

missing_concepts: weeping/grief at parting from the rebbe
the rebbe's empathy with his followers' sorrow
